name: tts-smoke
description: Agent-style sentences for the T3 TTS smoke tier: short replies, questions, long sentences and hard text (numbers, amounts, dates, times, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, URLs, abbreviations). 'entities' lists the spoken forms accepted for each hard-text item.

texts.text: Sure, one moment please.
Hi there! How can I help you today?
Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Did you say your zip code was 94107?
Got it, I've booked a table for four at the Italian place downtown.
Great news, your refund has been approved!
Your order number is 58213, and it should arrive within 3 to 5 business days.
The total comes to $42.50, including tax.
Prices went up by 12% compared to last year.
Drive 2.5 miles and take the second exit.
Your appointment is on Tuesday, March 3rd at 4:30 PM.
The contract was signed on July 14, 2025.
You can reach our support line at 555-0142.
Please send the receipt to anna.lee@example.com.
entities: anna dot lee at example dot com

texts.text: You'll find the full guide at docs.example.org/setup.
entities: docs dot example dot org slash setup

texts.text: Dr. Smith and Mrs. Jones will see you at the clinic tomorrow.
Your flight to NYC leaves from gate B12 at 7 AM.

Before we finalize your booking, I just want to double-check that the reservation is for two adults and one child, arriving on Friday evening and leaving on Sunday morning, with breakfast included each day.
If you'd like, I can also send you a text message with the confirmation details, the address of the hotel, and a link where you can manage your reservation online at any time.
